name: lab-assistant-rag
description: Cited graph-RAG lab-assistant chatbot template (Gradio): RAG over a lab's publications with inline citations, citation-graph expansion, cost-aware model routing, grounding guard, and lead capture.

paragraphs: A research-grade, reusable chatbot template for any research lab. Point it at a lab's publications and it does retrieval-augmented generation with inline citations, expands results along a paper graph (citation-graph flavour), routes cheap vs. expensive models to save cost, declines to answer when unsupported (grounding guard), and captures prospective-student / collaborator leads.

It ships with an illustrative, fictional lab (the Structured Intelligence Lab) as sample data so it runs out of the box — swap in a real lab by editing knowledge/ and a few settings. Built by Prarabdh Misra; originally built for a real research lab and generalized into this template.
